item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.47)] SpaceXAI Adopts NVIDIA Vera CPU to Accelerate Agentic AI at Massive Scale
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.47)
SpaceXAI will deploy NVIDIA Vera CPUs to accelerate its next generation of agentic AI applications, utilizing the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform for its Grok AI infrastructure and extending it into space with the Starmind AI satellite. This collaboration aims to scale SpaceXAI's computing capacity to gigawatts, with a common architecture extending from terrestrial data centers to orbital computing environments.

item.description:
